build.buildCommand: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run build; fi && if [ -f backend/requirements.txt ] && command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r backend/requirements.txt; fi

deploy.startCommand: if [ -f start.sh ]; then bash start.sh; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm run start; else echo 'No start command available for this service root' >&2; exit 1; fi
